headline: Annual growth holds despite a tougher sequential comp
summary_short: Revenue was $4,146M, up 10.4% y/y (down 0.6% q/q); diluted EPS of $4.12 rose 17.7% y/y but fell 12.2% q/q against an unusually strong first quarter.
summary_long: Revenue of $4,146M rose 10.4% y/y but slipped 0.6% q/q. Operating income of $1,801M grew 16.1% y/y yet fell 10.0% q/q; EBITDA of $2,124M rose 13.3% y/y, down 8.1% q/q. Net income of $1,217M increased 13.5% y/y, down 12.8% q/q. Diluted EPS of $4.12 rose 17.7% y/y, down 12.2% q/q. Gross margin was 71.9% (+1.7ppt y/y); operating margin 43.4% (+2.1ppt y/y, -4.6ppt q/q); net margin 29.4% (+0.8ppt y/y).
